description:
3/20/2026
This is an amendment to the Special Notice   Industry Day, 36C25926Q0353
The purpose of the amendment is to change the format from virtual to written questions and answers.
The questions will be posted through an amendment by April 14th, 2026.
Prior to that time interested vendors are encouraged to email their capabilities to Tamanica.danford-leaf@va.gov.
 The capabilities should directly address in-person (by the vendor s company) dialysis services provided to medical centers.
